title: UK to produce 'middle strike,' long-range drones for Ukraine in Britain
summary: Kyiv and London finalized an agreement on Nov. 21 that will see the United Kingdom manufacture "middle strike" and long-range drones for Ukraine on British soil, Ukraine's Defense Ministry announced.

title: Moldova, Finland report Russian airspace violations day after suspected Russian missiles flew into Poland
summary: Both Moldova and Finland reported separate instances of airspace violations by Russia on Nov. 21, officials said, just one day after two suspected Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone fell on Polish territory.
